plugins.name: soleon-observer
plugins.description: Read-only access to Soleon: agents, traces, failures, usage, evals, ideas and wiki. Requests no write consent — the least-privilege way to connect Claude Code to Soleon.

plugins.name: soleon-builder
plugins.description: Everything in observer, plus the agent build loop: create and update drafts, deploy and promote agents, bind channels, author custom MCP servers and knowledge bases. Includes the deploy-agent skill (identity markdown → Allium spec → validated POST /agents).

plugins.name: soleon-admin
plugins.description: The full Soleon surface, including the platform-admin-only families: channel and custom-MCP instance reads, eval runs, and discovery. For platform administrators.
